title: m4-csv-jsonl
prompt: Write a function convert(csv_text) in convert.py that turns CSV text into JSON Lines: one JSON object per data row, keyed by the header. Header names are trimmed. Values that look like integers or decimals become numbers, empty values become null, everything else stays a string. Quoted fields containing commas or newlines must work. Skip completely blank lines. Return a string with one object per line and no trailing newline.
